description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeEventService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods such as saving employee events, retrieving user roles, and fetching employee events. It utilizes PHPUnit for mocking dependencies and verifying behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeEventServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeEventService, covering methods for saving events, retrieving user roles, and fetching employee events.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Tests the saving of an EmployeeEvent entity via EmployeeEventService.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests the full saveEvent process, including setting notes, dates, and user roles.

methods.name: testGetUserRole
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of user roles, returning 'System' if no user is present, or the user's role name.

methods.name: getUserRoleDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data for testGetUserRole, yielding different user and expected role name combinations.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Tests fetching employee events with a mocked DAO.
